subject: CYCLE-1 TEST-RESULT: baseline Flex Deck boundary oracle 5/5 PASS
body: Cycle1 source/model boundary oracle PASS 5/5. Proven only at SOURCE/MODEL level: (1) a separate nonfocusable accessibility deck is source/API-feasible; (2) existing fold overlay is intentionally non-interactive; (3) current service metadata does not enable gesture dispatch; (4) current metadata does not enable semantic window-content/node actions; (5) privileged raw-input/task control remains unpromoted without isolated field proof. Cycle1 falsifies the broad design 'reuse existing overlay as universal native-like touchpad'. Proceeding to Cycle2 with separate capability tiers, exact DeckSession tokens, posture hysteresis, security/native-panel conflict gates, and adversarial stale/restart/remap/capability-loss tests.

service.blocker: Physical Fold7 runtime behavior not tested
